title: Exercise in Heat
population: People exercising in hot weather; general precautions, not individual medical clearance
prerequisites: Read the complete CDC precautions and choose activity appropriate to your circumstances.
limitations: No individual water dose, medication changes, heat-acclimatization schedule or guarantee against heat illness is supplied.
This page does not interpret heart-rate or effort logs or assess heat illness.
No independent human or clinical review.
stopRules: If you feel faint or weak, stop all activity and move to a cool place.
Seek medical care immediately for symptoms of heat-related illness, as CDC advises; this page does not diagnose the symptoms.

claims.text: CDC identifies greater dehydration and heat-related illness risk when exercising on hot days.
CDC advises cooler-time scheduling, gradual pacing, light loose clothing and teammates monitoring one another.

review.reviewer: Codex source verification and automated validation; published_personal_use; no independent human review
